key_patterns: Pine->cAlgo mapping: Pine high[size] = size bars back = Bars.HighPrices.Last(size) where Last(0) is the current forming bar. OnBar fires at the OPEN of a new bar, so the just-closed bar is Bars.Last(1); treat index 1 as the 'current' evaluation bar to match Pine 'confirmed on close'. Pine ta.crossover(close, level) = close[1] <= level && close[0] > level -> in cAlgo evaluate at the just-closed bar: close two-bars-ago <= level && just-closed close > level. leg(size): newLegHigh = high[size] > highest(size) over the window; newLegLow = low[size] < lowest(size). Pivot high/low tracked with currentLevel/lastLevel/crossed/barIndex. Trend bias BULLISH=+1/BEARISH=-1. FVG in leg: scan k from break bar backwards to broken pivot (cap 300) for LAST same-direction 3-candle FVG (bull: low[k] > high[k+2]; bear: high[k] < low[k+2]); record price-ordered top/bottom + direction. Structure/leg/trend state MUST persist in fields, not locals. Use one Label constant + per-order unique labels (incrementing counter field) to filter own PendingOrders/Positions/History. Place exactly ONE order per confirmed break (the last FVG in the leg). NO projection drawing (dropped per user instruction).
